opening.argument: The title, “Earn Passive Income with MTI - Grow Your Bitcoin,” promotes MTI as a route to passive Bitcoin income. The narration reinforces that financial proposition by claiming that “MTI has a proven historical record of being able to provide their members with an average daily profit of 0.5%.” It then pairs that return claim with a requested next step: “How to Register: ♐️ 1. Click the link below to ...” This connects advertised financial participation to an audience action. The record does not establish a payment step, the link’s destination, whether the claimed return was achieved, or any resulting loss.
